about_the_game:
VED: Journey Beyond the Cube - Demo

Experience the Beginning of an Enigmatic Puzzle Adventure

Step into the world of VED: Journey Beyond the Cube and uncover the mysteries of a surreal, shape-shifting realm. This demo offers a glimpse into the full game by letting you explore the first half of Chapter 1, where you’ll get a taste of the puzzle mechanics and story-driven adventure that awaits.

What’s Included in the Demo?

✔ The First Half of Chapter 1 – Begin your journey as Ved, an ordinary man who stumbles upon an ancient cube that changes his reality forever.

✔ Introduction to Core Gameplay – Experience cube-based movement, environmental interactions, and early puzzle mechanics.

✔ A Taste of the World’s Mysteries – Discover the atmospheric environments and unfolding story inspired by Hindu mythology.

✔ No Time Limits – Explore at your own pace and familiarize yourself with the game’s mechanics before the full release.

This demo provides a small but meaningful slice of the full game experience, allowing players to get a feel for the mechanics, art style, and story direction.

Future Plans

🌟 Full Game Release: The game will feature 7 chapters, each with unique environments, deeper puzzle mechanics, and expanding lore.

🌀 New Abilities & Challenges: Ved’s transformation will evolve with new elemental abilities, adding complexity and creativity to puzzle-solving.

🎭 Expanded Storytelling: Uncover more about the cube’s origins, Ved’s fate, and the deeper mysteries hidden within this surreal world.

🎵 Enhanced Audio & Atmosphere: The final version will feature a fully immersive soundtrack and refined sound design to elevate the experience.

🎮 Controller Support & Optimizations: We’re working to ensure seamless gameplay across different control schemes and smooth performance on all supported platforms.

Dare to enter VED: Journey Beyond the Cube. The path is yours to shape.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description

VED: Journey Beyond the Cube features mild fantasy violence and dark surreal imagery of self-discovery and transformation. The game includes mystical and mythological elements inspired by Hindu mythology but does not contain explicit violence, sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. Some scenes may evoke tension or unease, making it more suitable for mature audiences.

short_description: Ved is trapped in a strange world, transformed into a cube. Solve puzzles, unlock hidden powers, and explore a shifting reality to find a way back home.
